name: large tumor suppressor kinase 2
pathways: negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity

function.text: LATS2 encodes serine/threonine-protein kinase LATS2. Annotated molecular activities include protein serine kinase activity and protein serine/threonine kinase activity. It participates in negative regulation of cyclin-dependent protein serine/threonine kinase activity and intracellular signal transduction.
